definitions.ell_kin: enstrophy-weighted second moment with the Gamma/4pi^2 floor (forced_core.py ell_from_moment)
definitions.ell_ref: same estimator on the Nyquist-truncated target at the same time (removes estimator/grid bias from lag)
definitions.grid_floor: min over the run of ell_ref (the estimator's floor on this grid)
definitions.k_omega: sqrt(sum k^2|w_hat|^2 / sum |w_hat|^2)  (= sqrt(2)/l for a Gaussian)
definitions.lag: ell_kin/ell_ref - 1; arrest = first lag > 0.10; ell_arrest = min over the run of ell_kin

units: v_th = c_s = 1, nu = tau = lambda; target = forced_core.py column (l0 = 0.8, Gamma = 2 pi nu Re/0.63817) on [0,2pi)^2
